Qualifications Strong Motion Design and Motion Graphics skills, with a portfolio showcasing digital product and content work. Proficiency in industry-standard tools (e.g., After Effects, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, Photoshop, or equivalent motion/animation software). Ability to adapt visual styles to fit educational, gamified, and culturally rich content for diverse audiences. Strong visual storytelling, typography, and layout skills, with attention to detail and consistency. Comfort working in a remote, collaborative environment, with clear communication and reliable self-management. Understanding of or interest in African languages and cultures is highly beneficial; experience in edtech or gaming is a plus.
